title: Yoroiden Samurai Troopers, Volume 2
originalTitle: 鎧伝サムライトルーパー　２巻
summary: The second manga volume brings in the Inferno Armor, Kayura, and Badamon, then diverges into an original and melancholy ending. The four Warlords merge into the monster Rajao, Kayura awakens as a Kaos descendant, Jun wears Rekka armor, and the heroes become a projectile to destroy Arago's Netherworld moon. The source page stresses how far this ending moves from the TV version.
